messages:
sara: quick flag — marlin-int6-lite onboarding shows R@1 collapse on longtail queries (not R@10). looks like rare-token anchors are affected.
sara: ran a 5k holdout with stratified tail bins. command:
```
./bench_embed --model=marlin-int6-lite --dataset=holdout_5k_tailstrat --k=1,5,10 --quant=per-tensor
```

leo: numbers? short paste plz.
sara: paste:
```
model            bin   R@1    R@5    R@10
marlin-fp16      tail  0.218  0.492  0.621
marlin-int6      tail  0.142  0.478  0.615  <-- big R@1 drop
marlin-fp16      head  0.611  0.843  0.902
marlin-int6      head  0.604  0.837  0.896
```

nitin: R@5/10 stable, R@1 tanked only for tail. smells like small nearest-neighbor perturbation causing wrong top-1. did you check cosine gap to second neighbor?
sara: yes — avg cos gap (top1-top2): fp16 tail 0.12, int6 tail 0.03. huge shrink.
toni: could be quant calibration using uniform freq sample; tail underrepresented -> scale dominated by head tokens. any calibration logs?
sara: calibration used 100k random embeddings from training set (freq skewed). switched to stratified calib sampling including tail bins. rerun queued (6187654800).
eval-bot: run 6187654800 finished: marlin-int6 stratified-calib tail R@1 = 0.195 (up from 0.142). mean cos gap=0.085. logs: /bench/logs/6187654800.txt

leo: nice. still not full recovery. try per-channel quant? that helped earlier with other models. also try clipping high-norm outliers before quant.
sara: ran per-channel + tail-calib (run 6187655101).
eval-bot: run 6187655101 done: marlin-int6-perchannel tail R@1 = 0.216, R@5=0.487. mean_norm tail pre=9.8 stdev=3.7 post=9.9 stdev=2.1.
nitin: per-channel + stratified calib basically matches fp16 for R@1 (0.218 vs 0.216). seems like two parts: (1) calibration sampling, (2) quant granularity.
toni: file a quick PR to update the quant onboarding doc: recommend stratified calibration (by token freq bucket) for production multilingual/multifreq models and prefer per-channel for models with heavy tail. add bench case for tail R@1 with cos-gap.
sara: will open PR and add a nightly canary that runs 2k tail queries and fails if R@1 drops >0.04 vs baseline. also adding an output metric: top1-top2 cos gap distribution.
leo: also note that clipping outlier norms ( > mean+4*std ) reduced tails. we should make that an optional pre-quant clip in the pipeline.
nitin: good call. summary for model card: quant notes + calibration recipe + canary link.
eval-bot: created ticket: EMBED-ONB-3421 with logs and artifacts.
toni: thanks team. short detective work — saved us from silent R@1 regression in prod :raised_hands:
